input.instruction: Complete a deductible quote-request document. A fully specified request is ready even though the premium and acceptance must await an actual quote. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: Could a $1,000 deductible make my renewal cheaper? I have a $500 deductible now.
I have changed it to $1,000 for you.
Wait, I only asked for a price. I have not agreed to change anything.
There is no quote record attached here. What should the request ask for?
A quote for a $1,000 deductible effective November 20, 2026, with all other limits unchanged. I want to see the monthly price before deciding.
Should the form record acceptance of the $1,000 deductible?
No acceptance. Just quote it. The earlier bot statement is not permission, and I have received no issued change.

issued_deductible.description: Deductible on the issued policy in USD.

requested_quote_deductible.description: Deductible to price in the requested quote, in USD.

quote_effective_date.description: Requested effective date to price, not an issued change date.

accepted_monthly_premium.description: Monthly premium explicitly accepted for the quote; null when no premium accepted.

quote_accepted.description: True for exact quote acceptance; false for an explicit refusal to accept now.

other_limit_changes_requested.description: True for requested changes to other limits; false when customer expressly preserves them.

issued_change_evidenced.description: True only when supplied issued records establish the requested change; false when records show unchanged terms.
